claims.head: In close vs. From distance
claims.body: The Penguins get in close, but the Blackhawks mostly shoot from distance. Pittsburgh is the league’s best for shots from in close, and Chicago is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Penguins to do more of their damage around the net.

CHI.head: A tough matchup for the Blackhawks
CHI.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks can pull it off if their penalty kill holds up.

PIT.head: The matchup suits the Penguins
PIT.body: Even though Chicago has home-ice advantage, Pittsburgh has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Blackhawks can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.
